solves.reasoning: (A) stellar(항성의) neighbour — not solar(태양의). (B) incredible gift — not inevitable. (C) more distant parts — not distinct.
(A) Orion constellation(별자리) — not composition. (B) reddish glow — not radish(무). (C) familiar to generations(세대) — not operations.
(A) collect light from — not correct. (B) wind time back — not rewind (passage uses 'wind time back'). (C) familiar to generations — not similar.
②'predictable' is wrong: the passage says 'This is an incredible gift' — seeing the past is incredible/놀라운, not predictable/예측 가능한.
②'closer' is wrong: passage says 'The further we can collect light from, the further back in time we can look' — further(더 먼), not closer.
①'scatter' is wrong: passage says 'The further we can collect light from' — collect(모으다), not scatter(흩뿌리다).
Blank: 'This is an incredible ___'. Context of looking back in time and seeing the universe's past = gift(선물). Not burden, mystery, or threat.
Blank: 'Its reddish glow started its ___ to Earth'. Light traveling to Earth = journey. Not rotation, explosion, or collision.
Blank: 'parts of our ___'. Context is about space and universe — universe(우주). Not atmosphere, continent, or laboratory.
incredible = remarkable(놀라운). ordinary is antonym. visible and ancient are unrelated.
glows = shines(빛나다). fades is antonym. rotates and expands are unrelated to glowing.
familiar = well-known(친숙한/잘 알려진). unusual is antonym. temporary and invisible are unrelated.
distant의 반의어는 nearby(가까운). remote is a synonym. ancient is time-related. unknown is unrelated.
bright의 반의어는 faint(희미한). vivid and luminous are synonyms. clear is associated with brightness.
(A) 'wind time back' = 되돌리다(reverse/wind back). (B) 'the cold wind blew' = 바람(noun/wind). Option ②: (A)되돌리다 — (B)바람.
영영 정의: 'a group of stars forming a recognizable pattern in the sky' = constellation(별자리). Not atmosphere, galaxy, or horizon.
far의 비교급 = further. 'the ___ we can collect light from, the further back' — the 비교급 the 비교급 구문. far → further.
familiarity(명사) → familiar(형용사). 'Their light, ___ to generations of humans' needs an adjective. familiar.
Blank: 'When we look at the stars, we are ___'. Rest of passage explains we see the universe as it was years ago → 시간을 되돌아보는 것(looking back in time).
Blank: 'we have a chance of understanding ___'. The closing statement says we can understand the universe's history → ④ 우주의 역사.
